# The Vitest FORCE-FULL path set — `docs/decisions/ci-affected-tests.md` §2.1.
#
# Every entry is an input every test depends on that no test's import graph
# contains, so a diff touching one would have to run the WHOLE Vitest suite under
# affected-file selection; the ADR's table gives the reason for each and must
# equal this list.
#
# ⚠️ NO CI JOB READS IT. A pull request runs the whole suite again — the ADR's
# Amendment 1 reverted the selection (MOTIR-5948). It is kept, with the measuring
# script, as the input that re-opens that decision. Two things read it:
#   - `scripts/ci/measure-affected-tests.mjs`, with picomatch (`dot: true`);
#   - `tests/ci-changed-paths-gate.test.ts`, which asserts this list equals the
#     ADR's table.
#
# One glob per line. A line starting with `#` is a comment.
